outer_evaluation.ordering: the frozen start_date then deployment_id order
outer_evaluation.state_access: For each outer deployment starting at time t, Layer-B representation may use only focal-positive deployment outcomes whose end_date is strictly earlier than t, including outcomes from earlier outer deployments that have become available by then.
outer_evaluation.aggregate_metric_access: Generate every outer prediction in one deterministic prequential pass, then compute the aggregate outer metrics once after all predictions are fixed.
